limits: Snapshot candidates, not cancellation results or guaranteed runner-capacity recovery.
Current-head duplicates are all protected, even if multiple same-head runs exist.
Completed runs, main/push events and unrelated PRs are excluded by positive filtering; those event families were not queried.
Tree comparison is local and cheap; source/test/workflow subset excludes docs/** and *.md, without a semantic-equivalence claim.
No pass/fail/test-count/missing-test claim is inferred from statuses or job step conclusions.
No historical PR77 request, mutation, rerun, cancellation or auth change was performed.
owner_revalidation_before_any_cancellati: Re-read the exact run status/event/head/PR association and live PR head immediately before acting.
Skip any run that completed, matches a current head, changed attribution, or is not pull_request event.
Only the root owner is authorized to decide or issue cancellation; this inventory sends none.
